title: The geometry-to-visual identity chain — VISUAL_READY requires the release chain, and the evaluator is ONE
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2.3 (10 numbered requirements: the real artifact contract; ENGINEERING_GEOMETRY_READY vs VISUAL_INPUT_READY; the Engineering milestone's negative control; the Invention milestone's required validity state; the release chain hardened to Article LXXII; the identity chain enforced as ONE; typed-only package classification; the single join evaluator; the fourteen-attack false-positive battery; no visual-system redesign). Acceptance gate: R451-C2.3.
round_question: Can the system prove the exact engineering geometry -> canonical GLB -> Visual Compiler join WITHOUT trusting filenames, booleans, reports, or stale projections?
answer: YES — measured: every rung of the chain is now verified from bytes inside ONE evaluator consumed by both the dossier and the watchdog, and fourteen independently authored forgery attempts each fail to promote the state.

req_1_artifact_contract.what: geometry_available requires ALL seven authoritative conditions: canonical artifact exists AND non-zero AND valid artifact identity AND generation identities match AND every recorded SHA matches the bytes on disk AND engineering authority explicit AND no contradicting terminal failure. '/api/run/x/model' never establishes geometry (route strings resolve to nothing -> upstream_not_reached with the recorded detail). A missing engineering class stays UNKNOWN (the CIO's derived class is no longer an authority source). Legacy boolean-only projections remain readable but establish nothing (a legacy present=true may be a parametric-DEFINITION projection)

req_2_two_boundary_states.what: ENGINEERING_GEOMETRY_READY (verified artifact + explicit ENGINEERING authority) and VISUAL_INPUT_READY (the canonical GLB contract) are separate typed contract fields; a byte-valid STEP (ISO-10303-21 header checked) establishes the first and NEVER the second; the join state VISUAL_INPUT_NOT_READY and the strip class VISUAL_INPUT carry the honest gap

req_3_engineering_milestone.what: Engineering = RECEIVED only on the typed-valid geometry state AND the contract's ENGINEERING authority; the bridge-report fallback promotion is DELETED; the negative control (valid-looking BRIDGE_REPORT + no canonical geometry -> != RECEIVED) is proven in both batteries

req_4_invention_milestone.what: _invention_record_validity: the record's REQUIRED VALIDITY state decides — INVALID_EMPTY ({}), INVALID_MALFORMED (truncated JSON; never silently absent), INVALID_PLACEHOLDER (placeholder core fields), INVALID_MINIMAL (synthetic minimal record), INVALID_ADJUDICATION (the run's recorded rejection); only VALID receives the milestone; SURVIVOR_SELECTION with a named survivor is the era's canonical record

req_5_release_chain.what: verify_release_chain: canonical GLB identity -> invocation receipt identity (glb_sha256 == bytes; run_id == run; geometry_spec_sha256 == the spec file bytes) -> render record source identity -> gate PASS -> the required presentation artifact set on disk -> hero exists -> hero source identity (record source == canonical; an exported hero.glb must match the record's own view hash). Anything missing: not VISUAL_READY — the join state RELEASE_UNVERIFIED with the per-rung detail

req_6_identity_one_chain.what: geometry_spec_sha256 == receipt.geometry_spec_sha256; canonical_glb_sha256 == receipt.glb_sha256 == render_record.source_glb_sha256; hero source identity == canonical GLB — enforced INSIDE the evaluator (fail-closed typed states), never merely reported later by the watchdog

req_7_typed_package_classification.what: the free-text inference is DELETED ('transport' in reason.lower(), 'quality gate' in reason, transport_words); the class consumes the compiler's typed stages only: VISUAL_RELEASE_BLOCKED verdict -> VISUAL_GATE; QUALITY_GATE_BLOCKED -> SCIENTIFIC (B-/F-/G-/U- typed gate IDs) or PACKAGE_INTEGRITY; MODEL_VALIDATION_FAILED/COMPILE_ERROR -> PACKAGE_INTEGRITY; typed infra codes (reserved) -> INFRASTRUCTURE; anything else -> UNKNOWN verbatim, never guessed

req_8_single_evaluator.what: the geometry contract moved into toscanini/visual_join.py (ONE implementation); the watchdog's derive_join_state is DELETED (Art. LXIV disposition recorded) and the watchdog derives the join state from evaluate_visual_join over the run dir's own records; R10 couples the evaluator's announced state to the record invariants; the pre-C2.3 engineering-by-filename fallback is retired; the battery proves dossier and watchdog announce the SAME state on every fixture

req_9_ui_truth.what: the ribbon title is AUTHORITY-AWARE (renderBlockedTitle: ENGINEERING -> ENGINEERING MODEL READY; CONCEPTUAL -> CONCEPTUAL MODEL; UNKNOWN/legacy -> GEOMETRY AUTHORITY UNVERIFIED); two new typed causes with their own sentences: visual_input_missing, release_unverified; the cause vocabulary stays closed (seven)

req_10_no_redesign.what: no cameras, materials, Blender, cinematic rendering, UI polish, or new 3D models — the round is exactly the identity chain and its battery
